type.description: Wire discriminator that makes a JSONL line the closing verdict record of the audit stream.

gate_id.description: The audit gate this verdict judges, e.g. "gate-1".  Bound to the gate the driver is actually evaluating; a verdict naming a different gate is rejected.

envelope_sha256.description: 64-char lowercase hex SHA-256 of the evidence envelope this verdict judges.  The exact hex shape and the 64-char bound are enforced by the code-level validator (the generic validator implements no `pattern` keyword).

summary.description: Bounded to 500 characters by the code-level validator (the generic validator implements no `maxLength` keyword).

block_reason.description: Required when `verdict` is "block".  Bounded to 200 characters by the code-level validator.

acknowledgement_required.description: Required when `verdict` is "block": the veto is not self-overrulable and a human acknowledgement must be recorded before the gate can be reconsidered.
